# cpanel_directory_privacy (Data Source)

Looks up password-protection status for an existing directory in a cPanel account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_directory_privacy" "downloads" {
  directory = "public_html/downloads"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory` (String) The normalized directory path relative to the cPanel account home.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_directory` (String) The absolute directory path reported by cPanel.
- `auth_name` (String) The label displayed by HTTP Basic authentication. Empty when protection is disabled.
- `auth_type` (String) The authentication type reported by cPanel.
- `password_file` (String) The password file path reported by cPanel. Empty when protection is disabled.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the directory as protected.
